$comment: CosLog single source of truth. Generated from index.html (JS) and cross-checked against coslogx (Rust). Edit this file, not the editions.
transform: mirror X first (x -> -x), then rotate r*90 degrees clockwise; text is never mirrored
pathSyntax: Space-separated numbers per command. M x y | L x y | A cx cy r a0 a1 ccw(0|1) (radians, canvas arc semantics, implicit line to arc start) | C x1 y1 x2 y2 x y | Q x1 y1 x y. Numbers inside {} are wiper expressions: w, w-4, w+4.

whenSyntax.state: runtime state field name with eq|bit
whenSyntax.value: lt|gt than N on parsed v

messages.empty: Place parts, wire them (click a pin to start a wire), add a Ground, then press Run.
messages.noGround: No Ground part: node voltages and meters have no reference. Add a Ground.
messages.shortedTerminals: {name} has both terminals on one node (shorted by wiring).
messages.dangling: Unconnected pin(s): {list}{more}. Wire them or remove the part.
messages.noDcPath: No DC path to ground at: {list}. Readings there are unreliable. Connect to ground or add a bleed resistor (capacitors and open switches block DC).
messages.noConverge: Solver did not converge in {n} step(s) (last change {md}). Try: series resistance on diodes/LEDs/sources, lower op-amp gain, check transistor polarity, or lower the speed.
messages.lag: Cannot keep real-time on this CPU, so the simulation runs slower than the speed setting. {hint}
messages.lagHintAuto: Auto quality has coarsened the time step to keep up.
messages.lagHintManual: Set Quality to Auto or Fast, or simplify the circuit.
messages.nodeVoltage: Node voltage reached {v}: usually a floating node, a shorted ideal source, or a missing ground path.
messages.sourceRunaway: {name} supplies {i}: probably a short circuit. Add series resistance.
messages.fuseBlown: {name} has blown (open). Press Reset to replace it.
messages.shortTrace: {name} is short-circuited through {via}. Marked in red on the schematic.

diagnostics.nameRule: display name = n if non-empty, else part code

formatters.value: v + (u ?? labelUnit) + valueSuffix entries (" {f}{unit}"); empty when v is absent
formatters.meter: rms if ac > 2% of rms and > 1e-6, else average; units V or A
formatters.logic: HIGH if av > threshold else LOW

sg.name: Signal Gen
sg.keywords: function generator clock pulse square triangle

tm.name: 555 timer
tm.keywords: 555 ne555 timer astable monostable oscillator pulse blink

srf.name: SR flip-flop
srf.keywords: flip flop latch set reset memory
